snippet.title: Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out this new gameplay trailer for Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Service, a brand new cozy game from Destroyer Doggo. Take your Panda around a particularly dirty town, cleaning at your own pace as you make everything just that little bit cleaner. The soothing gameplay was designed to be the perfect pairing with some relaxing music or an audiobook. Bring up to 4 friends along and clean together! 
Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services is coming soon for PC (Steam), Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S
